data.narrative:
Vyriy Drone is a Growth-stage company in the Defense & Security sector, founded by Oleksiy Babenko, that has raised $4M+ through M&A activity as of 2025. The broader Defense & Security sector includes 10 known comparables (2 public traded entities and 8 private firms), among them established players such as Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI, though none sufficiently proximate in stage and valuation tier to support a robust peer-median benchmark.

Given the lack of narrow-stage peer density, valuation relies on stage-progression methodology applied to the $4M total raised as a baseline proxy. A typical Growth-stage advancement multiplier of 1.2x is applied, yielding an implied valuation of $5M. The low-end anchor ($4M) reflects the capital already deployed; the high-end estimate ($6M) incorporates upside from stage-progression with modest buffer for near-term momentum.

This single-method triangulation—constrained by peer availability—supports a median valuation range of $4.8M to $5.2M, with a reasonable band of $4M to $6M. Key uncertainties include the composition and terms of the M&A capital (whether strategic or financial), revenue traction or burn metrics post-raise, and competitive positioning within the crowded drone-defense segment. Peer-median benchmarking should be revisited once comparable late-Growth or Series A transactions in defense robotics emerge.
